description.en: A native DSH collaboration workbench for user-configured harness teams: member and author configuration views, shared-capability discovery, task continuation, paginated recovery records and native scheduled work. Includes a supervised DSH-to-Codex review and DSH repair case. Technical preview; members and models require separate setup, and universal autonomy or automatic improvement propagation is not established.
description.zh: 面向用户自配 Harness 战队的 DSH 原生协作工作台：分别展示作者与成员配置，支持共享能力发现、任务接续、恢复记录分页和原生定时工作。包含一次有监督的 DSH 委托 Codex 审查并由 DSH 修复的案例。技术预览；成员与模型需另配，不宣称全团自治或改进自动传播。
